title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Rewards Bonus on Guest Gift Totals
content:
The rewards guest gift total bonus of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry follows the sum of the amounts of all guest gift entries on the registry, the gift being accrued included. It is added, in percentage points, to the percent at which that gift accrues registry rewards, on a registry type whose registry rewards percent is above zero:

| Sum of all guest gift entries on the registry | Bonus added |
|---|---|
| at least USD 4500.00 (the upper guest gift total) | 2 percentage points (the upper guest gift rewards bonus) |
| at least USD 2000.00 (the lower guest gift total) but below USD 4500.00 | 1 percentage point (the lower guest gift rewards bonus) |
| below USD 2000.00 | none |

### Threshold cases (hypothetical registries)

| Guest gift entries before the gift | Gift being accrued | Sum | Bonus |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 4300.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 4500.00 | 2 |
| USD 4300.00 | USD 199.99 | USD 4499.99 | 1 |
| USD 1900.00 | USD 100.00 | USD 2000.00 | 1 |
| USD 1900.00 | USD 99.99 | USD 1999.99 | none |

### Basis Q&A

**Is the gift being accrued counted in the sum?** Yes, it is included.

**Which entries are summed?** The amounts of all guest gift entries recorded on the registry.

**Does the bonus apply on a registry type that earns no registry rewards?** No; such a type accrues nothing.
